prompt: The attached image is a 240x294 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240, initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden figure</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:294px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:294px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,294);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfffcf3);
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,147,-147,0.1,2000);
ref.position.set(0,147,500);
ref.lookAt(0,147,0);

function group(parent,name,x=0,y=0,z=0){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name; g.position.set(x,y,z); parent.add(g); return g;
}
const figure=group(scene,'character-golden-figure',-21,0,0);
const trunk=group(figure,'torso');
const head=group(figure,'head',1,235,0);

const grain=`
  vec2 p=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
  float screenDot=fract(p.x*.51+p.y*.251);
  float noise=fract(sin(dot(mod(p,256.),vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*43758.5453);
  gl_FragColor.rgb+=vec3((screenDot-.5)*.072+(noise-.5)*.038);
  gl_FragColor.b+=.044*sin(p.x*2.08+p.y*1.59);
`;
function surface(color,painted=false){
  const m=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,vertexColors:painted,roughness:.95});
  m.onBeforeCompile=s=>{s.fragmentShader=s.fragmentShader.replace('#include <dithering_fragment>','#include <dithering_fragment>\n'+grain);};
  return m;
}
const painted=surface(0xffffff,true);
const col=c=>new THREE.Color(c);
const clamp=THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
function fade(a,b,x){let t=clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t);}
function mix(a,b,t){return a.clone().lerp(b,clamp(t,0,1));}

// Each ring specifies height, transverse radius, depth, and the two center offsets.
function loft(parent,name,rows,paint){
  const points=[],colors=[],idx=[];
  const n=80, steps=6;
  function value(i,k,t){
    const p=rows[i],q=rows[i+1],a=rows[Math.max(0,i-1)],b=rows[Math.min(rows.length-1,i+2)];
    const h=q[0]-p[0],u=(q[k]-a[k])*h/(q[0]-a[0]),v=(b[k]-p[k])*h/(b[0]-p[0]);
    return (2*t*t*t-3*t*t+1)*p[k]+(t*t*t-2*t*t+t)*u+(-2*t*t*t+3*t*t)*q[k]+(t*t*t-t*t)*v;
  }
  const count=(rows.length-1)*steps;
  for(let j=0;j<=count;j++){
    const i=Math.min(rows.length-2,Math.floor(j/steps)), t=j/steps-i;
    const y=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(rows[i][0],rows[i+1][0],t);
    const rx=Math.max(.025,value(i,1,t)),rz=Math.max(.025,value(i,2,t));
    const cx=value(i,3,t),cz=value(i,4,t);
    for(let k=0;k<n;k++){
      const angle=k*2*Math.PI/n, sx=Math.sin(angle),fz=Math.cos(angle);
      points.push(cx+rx*sx,y,cz+rz*fz);
      const c=paint(y,sx,fz);
      colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(j<count){
        const a=j*n+k,b=j*n+(k+1)%n;
        idx.push(a,b,a+n,b,b+n,a+n);
      }
    }
  }
  for(let k=1;k<n-1;k++)idx.push(0,k+1,k,count*n,count*n+k,count*n+k+1);
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(points,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,painted);mesh.name=name;parent.add(mesh);return mesh;
}
const honey=col(0xf4ac24),amber=col(0xe59a28),gold=col(0xffc32e);
loft(trunk,'pear-shaped body',[
  [64,3,5,1,0],[69,25,21,1,0],[80,43,34,1,1],
  [98,54,43,0,2],[124,59,48,-1,3],[148,56,46,-2,3],
  [173,48,39,-3,1],[193,44,32,-3,-1],[211,43,29,-3,-2],
  [226,35,26,-3,-1],[240,26,22,-2,0],[249,18,17,0,0],[253,1,2,0,0]
],(y,x,z)=>{
  let c=mix(amber,gold,fade(102,216,y));
  const front=fade(-.18,.87,z);
  const patch=Math.exp(-Math.pow((y-155)/44,2))*front;
  c=mix(c,col(0xffda99),patch*.97);
  c=mix(c,col(0xffb979),front*.6*Math.exp(-Math.pow((y-186)/15,2)));
  return c;
});
loft(head,'rounded crown and cheeks',[
  [-15,4,7,-1,-1],[-7,18,18,-1,0],[1,25,22,-1,0],[11,24,23,0,1],
  [24,22,21,1,1],[33,18,18,2,0],[39,11,12,2,0],[41,1,2,2,0]
],(y,x,z)=>mix(col(0xed9d22),col(0xffcd36),fade(0,30,y)));

function oval(parent,name,pos,scale,color,rot=0){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,32,24),surface(color));
  m.name=name;m.position.set(...pos);m.scale.set(...scale);m.rotation.z=rot;parent.add(m);return m;
}
function tube(parent,name,coords,radii,color){
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(coords.map(v=>new THREE.Vector3(...v)));
  const geo=new THREE.TubeGeometry(path,28,1,12,false),attr=geo.attributes.position;
  const v=new THREE.Vector3();
  for(let j=0;j<=28;j++){
    const t=j/28,mid=path.getPointAt(t),s=t*(radii.length-1),k=Math.min(Math.floor(s),radii.length-2);
    const r=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(radii[k],radii[k+1],s-k);
    for(let i=0;i<=12;i++){
      const ix=j*13+i;v.fromBufferAttribute(attr,ix).sub(mid).multiplyScalar(r).add(mid);attr.setXYZ(ix,v.x,v.y,v.z);
    }
  }
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,surface(color));mesh.name=name;parent.add(mesh);
}
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const s=side,label=s<0?'left':'right';
  const eye=group(head,label+' eye',s*9+2,20,20);
  oval(eye,'sleepy eye socket',[0,0,0],[5.7,3.5,2.5],0xd7a024,-s*.07);
  oval(eye,'narrow eye opening',[.5,-.85,2.1],[3.5,.76,.7],0xaf872e);
  oval(eye,'heavy upper lid',[0,1,1.1],[5.3,2.5,2.1],0xe8b331);
  const arm=group(figure,label+' arm',0,0,-3);
  const drop=s>0?-5:0;
  loft(arm,'tapering arm',[
    [107+drop,3,3,s*61,5],[113+drop,4.4,5,s*60,4],[135,5.3,6.4,s*55,2],
    [158,6.3,8,s*48,-1],[180,10,11,s*40,-2],[199,12,12,s*36,-3],
    [214,9,10,s*33,-3],[225,1,2,s*30,-3]
  ],(y)=>mix(col(0x6d511c),gold,fade(107,152,y)));
  const hand=group(arm,label+' hand',s*61,110+drop,5);
  oval(hand,'palm',[s*2,-7,0],[6.2,10.8,4.4],0x60471e,s*.29);
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const a=-3.6+i*2.6, tip=-24+Math.abs(i-1.4)*2.1;
    tube(hand,'finger '+(i+1),[[s*(2+a),-10,1],[s*(4+a*1.2),-15,2],[s*(5+a*1.45),tip+3,2.5],[s*(5+a*1.5),tip,3.5]],[2.1,1.95,1.5,.3],0x4e4024);
  }
  tube(hand,'thumb',[[0,-4,2],[-s*2,-9,4],[-s*4,-14,5],[-s*4.8,-16,5]],[2.8,2.6,1.8,.4],0x655028);
  const leg=group(figure,label+' leg',s*18,0,-1);
  loft(leg,'leg',[
    [-20,7,9,s*.5,1],[-9,10,12,s*.2,0],[8,11.5,15,s*.2,0],
    [33,14.7,19,s*.8,0],[58,18,23,s*1.8,-1],[79,21,25,s*2,-1],
    [95,19,22,s*2,-1],[106,2,4,0,0]
  ],y=>mix(col(0xca811e),col(0xeea12c),fade(-4,75,y)));
  oval(leg,'foot',[s*.5,-20,5],[11,8,18],0xcc8921);
}
const mouth=group(head,'mouth',3,8.8,22);
oval(mouth,'lower lip',[0,-1.4,.6],[9.4,2.25,1.9],0xd99826,-.045);
tube(mouth,'closed mouth crease',[[-10,1,0],[-6,.1,1.7],[.5,-.3,2.3],[6,-.6,1.9],[10,-.1,.1]],[.32,1,1.15,.92,.25],0x79551f);
oval(head,'soft muzzle',[2.5,13.3,21.6],[9,4.4,3.3],0xeab02f);

const sky=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1600,1400),new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  depthWrite:false,
  vertexShader:`varying float h;void main(){vec4 w=modelMatrix*vec4(position,1.);h=w.y;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*viewMatrix*w;}`,
  fragmentShader:`varying float h;void main(){
    vec3 c=mix(vec3(.69,.69,.70),vec3(1.,.995,.975),smoothstep(-5.,44.,h));
    c=mix(c,vec3(.91,.925,.985),smoothstep(192.,251.,h));
    c=mix(c,vec3(.90,.89,.86),smoothstep(267.,301.,h));
    gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
    ${grain}
  }`
}));
sky.name='pale studio background';sky.position.set(0,147,-360);scene.add(sky);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffae9,0xffdfaa,1.65));
function light(x,y,z,color,power){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,power);
  l.position.set(x,y,z);scene.add(l);
}
light(-110,215,150,0xfff4cc,1.55);
light(130,80,65,0xffead5,.65);
light(-30,150,-140,0xffe6ad,.9);
function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref);}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[figure],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
